name: Etajima (Japan, city)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Etajima city emblem in light blue and blue: a stylised letter E of light blue and blue curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Etajima, a city in Hiroshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 November 2004.

features.role: Etajima city emblem — a stylised letter E of light blue and blue curved strokes
